svg.title: British Columbia / Parks — full arms cap badge
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The cap-badge scroll family is shared, with a separate dogwood, simplified framed arms or full-arms centre. Petal relief and small engraved lettering are idealized. The modern full achievement uses the exact uploaded native BC arms, uniformly fitted with its original geometry and stroke semantics. Two-tone engraved paint is a metal interpretation of that artwork, not authenticated die engraving.
